verdict.rationale: cfo.ai pulls in actuals from QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and Rillet. It answers questions like "why spending went up" and says each number "prints its lineage back to the source line", which points toward variance explanation and drill-down to transactions. Its Model supports Dimensions, which could carry department and account splits. Missing for 10: an explicit budget-vs-actuals or variance report, documented department-and-account variance breakdowns, a documented drill-down from a variance to the underlying ledger transactions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
